package main

import (
 "encoding/json"
 "os"
 "fmt"
 "reflect"
 lint "zabaplint"
)
type query struct{Type,Name string}
type update struct{Filename string;Raw *string}
type step struct{Label string;Updates []update;Queries []query;After []update}
type manifest struct{Files []lint.File;Config string;Queries []query;Steps []step}
func main(){
 raw,err:=os.ReadFile(os.Args[1]);if err!=nil{panic(err)}
 var input manifest;if err=json.Unmarshal(raw,&input);err!=nil{panic(err)}
 var c lint.Checker;c.Prime(input.Files,nil,input.Config)
 encoder:=json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
 current:=append([]lint.File(nil),input.Files...)
 apply:=func(updates []update){for _,u:=range updates{
  c.Update(u.Filename,u.Raw)
  at:=-1;for i,f:=range current{if f.Filename==u.Filename{at=i;break}}
  if u.Raw==nil{if at>=0{current=append(current[:at],current[at+1:]...)}}else if at>=0{current[at].Raw=*u.Raw}else{current=append(current,lint.File{Filename:u.Filename,Raw:*u.Raw})}
 }}
 freshMode:=len(os.Args)>2&&os.Args[2]=="--fresh"
 dump:=func(label string,queries []query){
 var fresh lint.Checker
 if freshMode{fresh.Prime(current,nil,input.Config)}
 for _,q:=range queries{
  issues,found:=c.CheckObject(q.Type,q.Name);files,treeFound:=c.Tree(q.Type,q.Name);if treeFound!=found{panic("existence differs")}
  if freshMode{
   want,wf:=fresh.CheckObject(q.Type,q.Name);tree,tf:=fresh.Tree(q.Type,q.Name)
   if found!=wf||treeFound!=tf||!reflect.DeepEqual(issues,want)||!reflect.DeepEqual(files,tree){panic(fmt.Sprintf("fresh mismatch at %s %s %s: incremental issues %v, fresh %v; tree equal %v",label,q.Type,q.Name,issues,want,reflect.DeepEqual(files,tree)))}
  }
  if err:=encoder.Encode(struct{Label,Type,Name string;Found bool;Issues []lint.Issue;Files []lint.FileTree}{label,q.Type,q.Name,found,issues,files});err!=nil{panic(err)}
 }}
 dump("baseline",input.Queries)
 for _,s:=range input.Steps{apply(s.Updates);dump(s.Label,s.Queries);if len(s.After)>0{apply(s.After);dump(s.Label+"-restored",s.Queries)}}
}
